earlier.why: the published run before the fixes of the benchmark findings; its reference arms still stand
Pointe arm only, after Pointe fixed what this suite found; same agent model, items, seeds and settings. Reference arms run no Pointe code: their rows come from the earlier run.

rules: Set before the first paid row: every arm in one interleaved launch, 3 runs of each of the 36 public items. No row starts while the 1-minute load is over 20. No launch is stopped for slowness. A row the harness marks as a fault (run.py finals --rerun-faults) or that errors is run once more and both rows are kept and listed; the rerun row is scored. Every launch and its spend are in results/ledger.jsonl.
